# KeyboardDeviceCount

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Keyboard](BlitzBasic-Keyboard)

</div>


```blitzbasic
KeyboardDeviceCount:Int32
```

**Returns:** The number of keyboards, at least 1. Where the system can't tell keyboards apart (for example on Wayland, or without a window) all of them count as one.

## Description

Tells how many keyboards the program has seen. A keyboard that is unplugged is still counted, and goes on having its number, see [KeyboardDeviceConnected](KeyboardDeviceConnected).

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
For i = 0 To KeyboardDeviceCount() - 1
	Text 10, 10 + i * 16, i + ": " + KeyboardDeviceName(i)
Next
Flip
WaitKey
```
